title: Nuanced Metrics for Measuring Unintended Bias with Real Data for Text Classification
reasoning: The paper introduces metrics to measure "unintended bias" in text classification models, specifically examining performance disparities across various "demographic groups," including religious groups (e.g., Christian, Jewish, Muslim, Atheist). The goal is to address "fairness" in AI, which is an ethical concern, by benchmarking how models treat different groups based on these sensitive attributes.
